title: System Control Board 3d: alarms grouped on the board and in Pulse; red only for a trip
why: Jason's design directive of 2026-11-18, the board's part (via the session manager and the Communications session; the one command header and the palette across the admin go to a design build). (1) GROUPED, 'Board and Pulse': open alarms sharing a system, level and kind's family are one row ('5 engine feeds held', naming what they hold) that opens to each alarm with its own buttons; Acknowledge all on the row. The key, in 0171 §8's note: the system from 0171's four (a workflow, task or a service a workflow reads → the Knowledge Engine; a worker → Workers; another service → Outside services; a site job, endpoint or stage → the site), the level, and the family (held, failing, slow, a red check); two or more make a group, one stays its own row. In Pulse one item 'alarms:<system>:<level>:<family>' with its alarm items as children (the shape agreed with the Communications session, which draws it); Done on it acknowledges each, assign and escalate pass to each. (2) COLOURS where 0171's lights are drawn: red (#a62b2b) only for a trip or a core host down; a process held by its check, a deferred source or a timeout is amber (#8f5600) with a pause mark, 'Held' or 'Holding'; warnings amber; a trip marks its row red and 'Tripped' even where it switched it off; a system's line counts tripped and held apart; the top bar's light the same. Every red and amber is drawn from the palette's tokens (--tv-fail, --tv-hold, Communications' and the design session's names) with their values as fallbacks, never a literal, so a palette change is one edit; the board's creams and browns wait for the design build's tokens. 0171 §8's note records the new Held light. 0171 §8 notes. Tests: r3d.php 18 (new), r2d 9 (its Holding pill now amber), r3c 28, r3b 21, r3a 25, r2b 14, w2-verify 5, layout 8, r1 33; rendered at 390px and 1280px with no sideways scroll; the group opened and Acknowledge all pressed. Built on Sync 21:23 UTC (3c, #143, live).
